verdict.rationale: Tilled offers some reconciliation-adjacent primitives—batch closing via API for easier reconciliation, a payouts view, webhooks for event notifications, and a 'reporting console' mention—but there is no documented settlement/balance report per seller or rolled-up report, no scheduled file/API delivery mechanism for finance-stack consumption. missing for 10: scheduled settlement/balance report generation, per-seller and rolled-up reporting API/files, explicit finance-stack export/schedule integration.
